findings: 132 numerical parity pairs are exact; all four unique retained image contents look unchanged in terrain seams, light, native hero, companion and HUD.
Width 12 is flat or slower. Width 24 gives approximately 3.27% and 2.07% weighted FPS gain, but fewer setup calls do not prove reduced GPU cost.

Worker 2 width 24 maximum is 411ms versus width 6 maximum 84ms, with 63 versus 64 slow frames overall. Worker 1 width 6 itself has a 361ms spike. Neither is discarded or treated as proof that width alone caused the stall.
